d: Training stations and relativistic jump points in Joe Haldeman’s The Forever War.

charon.x: Cryogenic proving ground on Charon where recruit William Mandella and the UNEF force endure brutal survival drills in 30 Kelvin conditions.

hip-21421.x: Dense collapsar jump point near Aldebaran used for instantaneous relativistic jumps across light-centuries of space.

b.s: Hugo and Nebula award-winning military sci-fi masterpiece examining the psychological alienation and extreme time dilation of interstellar war.
